liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Aladdin** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls this the best Aladdin heard, played right after an opening tune from the Fire Department album; Reviewer treats the opening Aladdin as a litmus test for whether a newcomer will like the band [4][5]
- **Breakout** (2 reviews): Reviewer describes Break Out as a new tune and already a favorite; Breakout is the first track on disc two [4][9]
- **Lenny** (1 review): Lenny runs straight into Turn It Out on the track listing [2]

## The recordings

- **soulive2004-07-01.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 10 songs; 116 min; rated 4.56/5 by 9 [1]. Said about its sound: Low end is slightly boomy; Recording sounds a little muted; Sound quality is rated pretty good [5][7][9][10]

## Around the show

- Lineup: Alan Evans on drums, Neal Evans on keys, Eric Krasno on guitar, Ryan Zoidis on tenor sax, Rashawn Ross on trumpet [2]
- Reviewer says the night opened with JMP and wants to find a taping of it [3]
- Rashawn Ross and Ryan Zoidis joining the band was a pleasant surprise for the reviewer [4]
- Reviewer is from Chicago, and this was their first exposure to Soulive [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **soulive2004-07-01.flac16**: taped by gruven42; source: AKG ck91 (XY@90°, balcony DFC) > mk90/3+h98 > se300b (no XLR cable) > Edirol UA-5 (Oade P-Mod) > optical > Creative Nomad Jukebox 3 (@44.1) [1]
